{{Quote|All right, ''now'' I'm worried.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith (video game)">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' video game]]</ref>}}
The '''B2 grapple droid''', based on the [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]] model, was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] model specifically designed for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]' [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attack]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Overview==
[[File:GrappleDroid.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A B2 grapple [[Droid/Legends|droid]].]]
Bigger and profoundly more vicious than its [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|predecessors]], the grapple droid was equipped with electrically charged industrial pincers, which are used to crush or impale enemies and obstacles. They could also be used to smash through stone walls. The grapple droid excelled at close-quarters combat and its embrace was quite deadly. They proved dangerously efficient against [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who, if grappled, were unable to use a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] himself personally oversaw its modifications.

==History==
[[File:RedGrappleDroid.png|thumb|left|180px|The red variant of the B2 grapple droid.]]
Grapple droids were used aboard the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] where they attempted to stop [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] rescue of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. In addition to being used during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], they took part in the occupation of Utapau. At times, they served as military police for the droid army. The [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]] saw the introduction of even more formidable grapple droid, one that had a red color scheme and was capable of sending powerful energy blasts across the ground towards a target by slamming their pincer into the ground. A [[Grapple droid (Antamont)|grapple droid]] was seen trying to stop a [[Lone battle droid|battle droid]] from deserting in the [[Battle of Antamont]].

[[File:Droids_and_Jedi_on_Invisible_Hand.jpg|180px|thumb|A grapple droid engaging Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker aboard the ''Hand'', along with [[B1-A air battle droid|air battle droids]].]]

Following the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|deaths]] of the members of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious's]] new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], Darth Vader, these units were deactivated along with the other battle droids.
